## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: narrow leadership (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 Top performers from Technology) and major divergence among large caps (AAPL, META, TSLA showing 1W vs 1M mismatches) — reduce risk gradually.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND. Materials and Industrials also showing strength: NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +5.07%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy, Utilities and Real Estate lag: XOM (1W: -1.54% | 1M: +11.33%) CORRECTION, VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND, Utilities overall showing weakness despite pockets. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: VLO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +6.48%) CORRECTION, F (1W: -4.77% | 1M: +2.72%) CORRECTION, MAR (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Energy/Utilities.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.69% | 1M: -9.68%) RECOVERY; note MAJOR DIVERGENCE among megacaps (AAPL, META, TSLA) — tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology mixed but leading on 1W strength: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.36% | 1M: -6.24%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: -0.51% | 1M: -1.28%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W: +9.24% (24 stocks) indicating internal rotation with narrow leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials holding but mixed: JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.99% | 1M: +4.11%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +7.60%) CORRECTION — sector breadth positive (1W: +1.48% / 20 stocks) but leadership skewed toward Tech-driven risk appetite; style: Growth/Momentum.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare steady with idiosyncratic winners: JNJ (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +0.05%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -1.77% | 1M: -5.70%) BELOW TREND — sector modestly positive (1W: +1.77% / 17 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor high-conviction names showing confirmed strength (MSFT, NVDA, PLTR) and selective cyclicals/materials (NEM, FCX); reduce exposure to lagging Energy/Utilities names showing CORRECTION or BELOW TREND. Given CAUTION and narrow leadership, monitor major-cap divergences (AAPL/META/TSLA) and treat recent rallies as tactical opportunities until broader confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY — watch for follow-through on bullish news. BEARISH: MAR (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND — downside risk confirmed by sentiment.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +9.24% / 24 stocks) and Materials (1W: +6.28% / 11 stocks) for momentum continuation. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.43% / 10 stocks) and Utilities (1W: -1.76% / 10 stocks) for continued dispersion and risk reduction.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND — hold weekly close above recent highs for continuation; AAPL (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY — failure back below month support would signal re-test risk; JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND — sustained outperformance would reinforce Financials participation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+80): Eli Lilly (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY — sentiment (blowout growth + raised outlook) confirming price bounce. CAT (+80): Caterpillar (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.09%) RECOVERY — earnings/guidance beat aligns with 1W strength and could extend the rebound.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
MAR (-45): Marriott (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirming price weakness. VST (-45): Vistra (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND and MNST (-45): Monster (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -6.41%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price action both negative.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, Growth/Momentum style. MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND and PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergences (AAPL RECOVERY, META RECOVERY, TSLA RECOVERY) and narrow Tech leadership, while bullish news for LLY/CAT warrants watching for selective follow-through.
